ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65:35 ratio of high-intensity white to low-intensity black pixels; white intensity dominant on lateral lobes, black intensity concentrated in central peduncle attachment region and extending to the mid-trailing edge.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous black pigmentation cluster surrounding the median notch extending basally; two distinct, high-contrast circular black blobs located in the mid-ventral region of the left lobe; diffuse black mottling at the interface of the central black mass and lateral white fields.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 40 degrees and a high depth-to-width ratio relative to the fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the right lobe trailing edge; two significant, high-amplitude semi-circular U-shaped indentations (bites or trauma) on the left lobe trailing edge; irregular jagged profile on the distal tip of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Asymmetrical sweep; right lobe exhibits a smooth convex curve tapering to a point; left lobe exhibits a truncated, irregular convexity due to trailing edge loss.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of two primary circular dark pixel clusters on the left lobe white field; multiple minor dark speckles concentrated near the upper trailing edge of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Major loss of tissue on the left lobe trailing edge characterized by two deep, smooth-edged concave notches; secondary jagged truncation of the far-left fluke tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Symmetry-breaking pigmentation: the left lobe contains a pair of large, isolated dark spots within the white field, while the right lobe remains primarily white with minimal focal spots.
